help_title: In the browser or in the terminal.
help_lead: The same idea in both: few decisions, explicit checks and clear results. These are the real jgates commands.
help_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it by hand.
help_step_init_text: Creates jgates.yml and the .jgates files from the languages the project uses.
help_step_ui_text: Configure templates, review the plan and follow the runs in a local interface that only serves your computer.
help_step_plan_text: Shows the plan before running any tool: what runs, what does not apply and what was left without coverage.
help_step_run_text: Runs exactly the plan and returns structured output, with the exit code the pipeline can use.
help_more_history: Lists the runs of this workspace.
help_more_baseline: Marks a run as the baseline to compare the next ones.
help_more_gc: Shows what retention would delete, without deleting anything.
help_more_doctor: Checks the runtimes and tools of the machine.
help_more_no_cache: Runs everything again, without reusing results from earlier runs.
help_more_waiver: Waives a finding only in this run, with a reason and an expiry.
help_more_preserve: Protects a run from retention cleanup.
help_faq_profile_q: What is the difference between profile and severity?
help_faq_profile_a: The profile sets the depth and cost of the checks. Severity sets which results block delivery. A fast profile can still block an exposed secret.
help_faq_architecture_q: Does JGates discover the right architecture by itself?
help_faq_architecture_a: It identifies files, languages and dependencies. The desired architecture is declared by you, in .jgates/architecture.yml: layers, limits and contracts that must be preserved.
help_faq_cache_q: Why did a result come back reused?
help_faq_cache_a: If nothing the stage reads has changed, the result of an earlier run is reused, and the result says which run it came from. Use --no-cache to run everything again.
help_faq_waiver_a: It takes a finding out of blocking, with a reason and an expiry. It never turns a tool that failed into approved: if the stage errored, the run stays unapproved.
help_faq_governed_a: The policy comes from outside the repository and governed fields appear locked, with the reason. The interface does not loosen what the policy requires.
help_keyboard_q: How do I use it with the keyboard only?
help_keyboard_a: Use Tab to navigate, Enter or Space to activate controls, Esc to close dialogs and the arrow keys to switch tabs. In the editor, Tab inserts two spaces; Esc moves focus out of the editor.
